llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed mumo integration that sends user-chosen deliberation prompts to an external multi-model service for decision support.

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown and JSON only, has no executable files, and its network/API use is limited to the declared mumo MCP service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup requires registering an external MCP server and storing a mumo API key in OpenClaw configuration; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill tells the agent when to use mumo and when to skip it, and it includes sensible verification and synthesis boundaries; users should remember prompts may include sensitive project context sent to mumo and model providers.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to normal OpenClaw MCP server configuration and skill installation; the share_session tool can create public session links, but the skill frames sharing as user-facing and not automatic.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, tool instructions, playbooks, and references all align around multi-model deliberation, claim-map review, snippets, and synthesis.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending deliberation prompts, attached designs, and possibly code or security-sensitive context to mumo's external service. Keep the mumo API key protected, and ask before using share_session if a session contains private material.
